findings: No credible duration failure exists through the current 20m safe lower bound, so there is not yet a failure-derived safety margin from which to promote an operating cap.
Even if 22m cleanly survives, it can only advance the exploratory SAFE_LOWER_BOUND after retrospective WAKE_OK; it cannot become OPERATING_CAP from a single run.
Phase B still requires >=5 clean runs at/near a candidate with representative W3/W5/(W4 or W6)/W7 coverage and no unresolved duration failure at or below candidate.
This guard prevents conflating maximum observed survival with production policy.
